title: Insert + query across relationships
summary: Create lab_teams / lab_players with FK relationship.
description:
Create lab_teams / lab_players with FK relationship.

Why: Inserts must respect FKs; queries must JOIN/include to reassemble the graph — schema alone is not enough for production thinking.
hints: Read gate errors as cause→effect: each message names what Postgres still lacks.

data.message: Insert at least two teams (and commit the session).

data.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM lab_players p JOIN lab_teams t ON t.id = p.team_id
data.message: Insert at least three players that belong to a team — the JOIN must return them.
